_comment: plan-herding.md H2 (R15): Hans's herding quest, which replaces `the-strays` in play (R7 keeps that file, unoffered). Two herding stages. FLOCK: drive six of the generic Sheep (78, `herd.pen hans-pen`) into the pen beside his house; a sheep counts after 2 s inside and credits every player it ran from in the last 10 s (D4/D5), so two players herding together both get it. STRAYS: Baabara, Woolliam and Lambert, each its own definition and therefore its own counter, waiting in three dangerous corners of Zone 1 with three temperaments (D12); one objective each, count 1, with an objective tracker so the journal ticks them one by one, the way the-strays ticked its talks. Talking to a stray is optional (R16). Counts start at stage entry, so a stray penned during the flock stage does not count. A new id rather than `the-strays` reused: a saved ledger sitting in that quest's talk stage would silently change meaning. Reward 180 XP on Hans's turn-in row = the L9 half-level rule at L2 [PLACEHOLDER: two stages make it longer; the price is a PO call at the text approval]. Text drafted by Claude, PO approval owed.
